{{Top|leg}}
'''Thruster-control jets''' were components on the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. Located at the rear of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] between the two [[J-77 "Event Horizon" sublight engine/Legends|J-77 Event Horizon]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]], the jets were used for maneuverability during flight.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
